reminder.notes:
Act on reminders without waiting for them to ring

### Features

Mark done, Snooze and Skip next are now available on every reminder in every
list, and a swipe right completes a reminder the way a swipe left deletes one.
Until now the only path to a completed reminder was the alarm screen or its
notification: a task finished early could only be deleted or disabled, so the
Done tab and the stats under-reported what actually got done. Every one of these
actions runs through the same scheduler and fire log a ring-time action uses, so
it advances the recurrence, clears the snooze, re-arms the next occurrence and
replicates to your other devices identically. Completing from a list holds the
same five-second undo window as deleting.

Completed reminders can be restored, and a Done card shows when it was actually
completed instead of when it was created.

The lists follow the clock. Countdowns and the Today counters were computed once
when the screen built and never again, so "in 5m" stayed "in 5m" and Overdue
stayed at zero for as long as the app sat open.

Today's today/overdue/this-week counters now open Upcoming filtered to exactly
what they count. Upcoming gains a state filter and a priority sort, and paused
and completed reminders became filters on that same list instead of living
behind Settings.

Quick add can save in one tap when it recognised a real time, and offers example
phrasings; a guessed time still goes through the editor first.

The month view swipes between months, keeps the day you had selected instead of
jumping to the 1st, and colours each day's dots by category.

Long-press starts a multi-select directly, the per-reminder actions moved onto a
visible control on the row, and the selection bar gained select-all.

The stats screen names the reminders you snooze rather than act on, so one
scheduled at the wrong hour becomes visible instead of just noisy.

Accessibility: the bottom bar shows its labels, icon-only controls carry screen
reader labels, and system font scaling is honoured up to 1.4x without clipping
the cards.

New app icon.

### Bug fixes

A pending snooze was judged against the system clock rather than the clock the
surrounding screen was using, so a reminder could be counted as snoozed and
un-snoozed at the same moment by two parts of the same list.

ai-scanner.notes:
AI Scanner 1.4.1 — Background update checks, and no more double-downloading updates

### Features
- AI Scanner now checks for updates periodically in the background (about every 6 hours) and posts a notification when one is found, in addition to the existing manual "Check for Updates" in Settings. Tapping the notification opens the app; the download and install still happen from the Settings sheet.

### Bug fixes
- The update downloader now persists its in-flight DownloadManager id and re-attaches to a still-running download instead of deleting the partial file and starting over — fixes re-downloading the same update from zero after backgrounding or reopening the app mid-update.
- The update sheet now re-syncs its progress on resume instead of occasionally showing a frozen progress bar.

mirrordrive.notes:
Show the app version and PNSJY branding in Settings

Settings now ends with the current app version and the PNSJY store branding, so every
PNSJY app presents the same footer.

### Features

- The Settings screen now shows the installed app version and a PNSJY brand footer as its
  last two items, consistent across all PNSJY apps.

### Bug fixes

No user-facing bug fixes in this release.
